about_short: Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality, Khanvel is a 10-bed family hospital managed by Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad — with 14 doctors across gynecology & maternity, paediatrics, medicine, surgery, ENT, skin, urology, dental and pathology, and 24×7 emergency services.
about: Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality is Dr. Sachin Shedad’s hospital at ND Complex, Khanvel Char Rasta, near Silvassa — a trusted centre for better healthcare for your whole family, with 10 beds, an operation theatre, labour room, NICU beds with phototherapy for newborns, a laboratory, pharmacy and 24×7 emergency care.

Women’s health and maternity care at the hospital follow the approach of Suvacha Healthcare, Dr. Sachin’s initiative guided by the mission “Creating श्रेयसी प्रजा” — integrating the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda with the scientific precision of modern medicine.

why_us_about: At Shobha Hospital, we believe that women’s health deserves care that is compassionate, ethical, and deeply rooted in understanding the body as a whole. Our approach combines the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda with the precision of modern medical science to provide safe, effective, and personalised care at every stage of a woman’s life.
From adolescence to motherhood and beyond, we focus not just on treating symptoms, but on identifying root causes, promoting prevention, and empowering women through education and holistic support.
founder_message: Shobha Hospital is built on the belief that a healthy woman creates a healthy society. By uniting Ayurveda’s timeless knowledge with modern medical science, we are committed to offering care that heals, strengthens, and empowers. Our goal is to nurture Shrēyasī Prajā — a generation that is physically strong, emotionally balanced, and spiritually enriched.
contact_intro: Whether you have questions about women’s health, pregnancy care, infertility treatment, or holistic wellness, our team is ready to guide you with care and clarity. We believe in listening first, understanding your concerns, and providing ethical, personalised healthcare solutions.

faqs.q: Where is Shobha Hospital in Khanvel?
faqs.a: Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality is at Shop No. 16–17, ND Complex, Khanvel Char Rasta, Khanvel, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli 396230 — right at the main Khanvel crossroads, easy to reach from Silvassa, Rudana, Dudhani, Kherdi and nearby villages. Call +91 97142 06386 (24×7) or WhatsApp +91 88677 61598.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Fill in the appointment form on this website — it opens WhatsApp with your details pre-filled so our team can confirm a slot. You can also call +91 97142 06386 or +91 88677 61598.
Yes. Shobha Hospital provides 24×7 emergency services. In an emergency, call +91 97142 06386 and come straight to the hospital at Khanvel Char Rasta.
Monday to Saturday 8:00 – 11:00 AM and 2:00 – 8:00 PM. On Sunday, consultations are by appointment. Emergency care is available 24×7.

faqs.q: Which specialists are available at Shobha Hospital?
faqs.a: Shobha Hospital has 14 doctors: gynaecologist & obstetrician, gynae-oncologist & laparoscopic surgeon, paediatrician, medicine specialist, general and laparoscopic surgeons, urologist, ENT specialist, skin specialist, dentist, pathologist and medical officers. Call +91 97142 06386 for each doctor’s OPD timings.

faqs.q: Do you have a laboratory and pharmacy?
faqs.a: Yes. The hospital has an advanced pathology laboratory and an in-house pharmacy, so most tests and medicines are available under one roof.
We strongly support normal delivery whenever it is medically safe, with continuous labour monitoring, while remaining fully ready for a caesarean section when it is medically indicated.
Yes. Along with visits at the hospital, our online consultation team offers gynecology and obstetric guidance, follow-ups and counselling. Choose “Online consultation” in the booking form.

faqs.q: Do you combine Ayurveda with modern medicine?
faqs.a: Yes. Diagnosis and medical decisions follow modern, evidence-based protocols, and classical Ayurvedic therapies, diet, yoga and lifestyle guidance are integrated alongside where they help.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.a: Bring any previous prescriptions, ultrasound reports, blood test reports and a list of current medicines. For fertility consultations, reports of both partners are helpful.
